description: TS successor to STRAT-AGENT-INTERP, which shipped in the Python engine (4651933) and was retired at the TS cutover: the TS IR declares agent as a literal enum (ts/src/ir/schema.ts:41,65) and both step and fanout-stage dispatch emit it verbatim (engine.ts). Let a step's agent and a fanout stage's agent resolve from recorded flow state: `${input.executor}`, a router step's output, or per fanout item `${item.agent}`, validated to a known agent before dispatch. Stays in the data plane (recorded state only; replay identical). First consumer: cross-provider per-item routing in compose COMP-FABLE-ASTRA (one wave mixing claude and codex workers), which today needs two fanout stages. Not required for per-item TIER routing, which compose resolves itself from the recorded item (STRAT-LOOP-CARRY). Standalone Tickets M medium

links.note: LOOP-CARRY records the item; this makes the agent field read it
